decisions.reason: Applying the reusable design format to location sites does not change the confirmed Smash Room brand name; the reference to changing branding does not explicitly replace that identity.
Reusing the visual format across sites does not change how visitors select a location or where that selection routes them.
The shared website format does not change the existing architecture in which each operational location has a separate Wix website and account.
The source message's reusable-format decision is already fully represented by the candidate's message 42 MODIFY, with no additional update, removal, or scope change required.
The same-message requirement to retain packages and prices unchanged is already represented by the candidate's message 42 INTRODUCE; the design scope change adds no further catalog-state change.
Extending the referenced visual format to location sites does not alter the master site's role of consolidating brand, location, and informational content.
The reusable cross-site design format does not necessarily change the existing goal of minimizing SEO damage during the Bay Area migration.
The source concerns reuse of site format, branding, wording, packages, and prices; it does not change Wix as the booking platform or the booking requirement's scope.
Sharing a website format across locations does not change the requirement that bookings, calendars, reporting, revenue, and sales data remain isolated by location.
The design-format reuse decision does not change the separate Wix payment setups or payout-isolation behavior for individual locations.
